summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, CEO and CFO certifications, and earnings and dividend press releases for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing reports ordinary quarterly results and a common and preferred share dividend declaration, with exhibits incorporated by reference into the registrant's F-3, F-10 and S-8 registration statements. No transaction, strategic action, ownership change or abrupt management event is disclosed; the document is a standard periodic earnings filing requiring no deal-terms analysis.
